description: This file defines a PHP class 'Subscription' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Extension\Opencart\Report'. The class contains methods for retrieving subscription data and statistics, including getSubscriptions() and getTotalSubscriptions(), indicating it is part of the data access layer for subscription reports in the OpenCart backend.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: A model class responsible for retrieving subscription report data from the database, including lists of subscriptions with filters and counts.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions based on filtering criteria such as date range, status, and grouping period, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions matching the specified filters, used for pagination and summary statistics.
